ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, with (preposition) · 'where' as a place conjunction (ኀበ ትነብር 'where she dwells'; ch. 17–19 headings)
ለንጉሥ: ንጉሥ — to the king, for the king (ለ- + noun)
ብዙኀ: ብዙኅ — many, abundant (adjective, masc. sg.; written ብዙኀ, adverbial/predicate) · attributive after an accusative noun (ሞገሰ ብዙኀ 'abundant grace')
ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
ዘይትፈቀድ: ተፈቀደ — what is needed, required (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect passive of ፈቀደ)
ሎቱ: ለ — to him, for him (preposition ለ- with 3m sg suffix -tu: ሎቱ)
ወውእቱኒ: ውእቱ — and he also (ወ- + pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
ላቲ: ለ — for her (preposition ለ- with 3fs suffix ላቲ)
ለለ: ለለ — each, every (distributive); uncertain in this context (see note on ተረፈ)
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her')
ወለለ: ለለ — and each, every (ወ- + distributive ለለ)
ኀቤሃ: ኀበ — to her, toward her (preposition ኀበ + -ሃ '3fs')
ወፍትሖ: ፍትሕ — and his judgment (ወ- + noun + -ኦ '3ms his', accusative)
ወጣዕመ: ጣዕም — and sweetness of (ወ- + noun, construct, accusative)
ነገሩ: ነገር — his speech, word, matter (noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
ወታስተአድም: አስተአደመ — and she resolves, sets her mind (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, Ct) (?)
ወታስተዐጽብ: አስተዐጸበ — and she reckons hard, finds difficult (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, ʾastä-stem; the same verb as ch. 22 ያስተዐጽብ 'he marvelled, was astonished'; sense unconfirmed) (?)
በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
በኀቤሁ: ኀበ — from him, with him (በ- + ኀቤሁ 'to him'; sense 'from him' preferred, 'to him' possible) (?)
በኅሊና: ኅሊና — by the thought, design of (በ- + noun, construct)
ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
እምብዝኀ: ብዝኅ — from the abundance of (እም- 'from' + noun ብዝኅ 'multitude', construct ብዝኀ)
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
ዘተናገረ: ተናገረ — which spoke, that speaks (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, reciprocal ተ- stem of ነገረ)
ወመሳውረ: መሳውር — and an implement (ወ- + noun; unidentified, uncertain)
ወኴሉ: ኵሉ — and all (ወ- + variant spelling ኴሉ)
ወከመ: ከመ — and that (ወ- 'and' + conjunction) · and like, and as (ወ- + ከመ 'like, as' before a noun: ወከመ ፈውስ ለድዉይ 'and like healing to the sick')
ይገብር: ገብረ — he does, makes (3ms imperfect, G, g-b-r)
ዘወሀቦ: ወሀበ — which he gave him (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 3ms object)
በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her')
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ
በኵሉ: ኵሉ — in all, by all (በ- + ኵሉ)
አንሰ: አነ — as for me (1cs pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
እምፈተውኩ: ፈተወ — if I wished (እም- 'if', though 'rather than' is possible, + 1cs perfect, G) (?)
ወሣእሣአ: ሣእሣአ — and the [śaʾśaʾä] of(?) (ወ- + unidentified noun, accusative or construct, lemma not established; sense unknown, perhaps something like order or fitness of speech; Dillmann unavailable)
መከይደ: መከይድ — tread, footstool (?) (noun, construct; from ከይደ 'tread'; uncertain)
ወአንሰ: አነ — and as for me (ወ- 'and' + 1s pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
ለዘ: ዘ — (to/of the one) whom (ለ- + relative pronoun; ወቦ ለዘ 'and there is one whom')
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
ጥበብሰ: ጥበብ — wisdom, as for her (noun, fem. + contrastive -ሰ)
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16)
ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he (3m sg independent pronoun) · also demonstrative 'that' before a noun (በውስተ ውእቱ ሥዕለ 'in that image') and copula 'it is' after a predicate (ጽድቅ ውእቱ 'true it is')
አሐውር: ሖረ — I will go (1cs imperfect, G)
